While the city guards patrol the Long Walk, the royal guards protect King Orgukagan and the royal family, as well as important royal interests. **[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 22 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 20 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17 [Hagegraf Royal Guard](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2697) **Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 86 **Perception** +16; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), iron mind **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Dwarven](/Languages.aspx?ID=3), [Undercommon](/Languages.aspx?ID=11) **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +13, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +10, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +10, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +10 **Str** +4 **Dex** +2 **Con** +3 **Int** +1 **Wis** +5 **Cha** +1 **Items** [Chain Mail](/Armor.aspx?ID=9), [Guisarme](/Weapons.aspx?ID=25), [light hammers](/Equipment.aspx?ID=24) (2), [simple manacles and key](/Equipment.aspx?ID=32) --- **AC** 22 **Fort** +14 **Ref** +11 **Will** +14 **HP** 90 **Iron Mind** Royal guards automatically disbelieve all [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92) of 2nd level or lower.
**[Light Blindness](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=22)**
**Stop Right There!** **Trigger** A creature within the royal guard's reach uses a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=114) action; **Effect** The royal guard Strikes the creature. On a success the target's action is interrupted; on a critical success the target is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31).
**Tight Formation** While adjacent to another royal guard, each royal guard gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=38), [Trip](/Actions.aspx?ID=40), or [Tumble Through](/Actions.aspx?ID=29) them. --- **Speed** 20 feet **Melee** guisarme +15 ([Reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Trip](/Traits.aspx?ID=196)), **Damage** 1d10+6 slashing plus [Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=20) **Ranged** light hammer +13 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [thrown 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)), **Damage** 1d6+6 bludgeoning **Occult Innate Spells** DC 21 - **Cantrips (3rd)** [Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286) - **2nd** [Blood Vendetta](/Spells.aspx?ID=675), [Paranoia](/Spells.aspx?ID=214) **Brutal Beating** A royal guard deals an additional 1d10 precision damage to prone creatures. **[Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=20)**
